'''Lus-Nati Fellaus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] who was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in his residence by the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Melo Centris]]. Security recordings showed Fellaus's sister entering and leaving the residence, but she was on the far side of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] when the murder occurred.
